newsitem.title: USA: Texaco confirms discussing joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Texaco confirms discussing joint venture.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Monday it is discussing a new venture with Shell Oil Co.

Texaco said the goal of the discussions is to create a more efficient competitive operation maximizing strength of both companies, including their brands to create a revitalized downstream business in the United States.
Texaco said the companies will spend the next few months trying to develop an alliance to benefit stockholders of both companies.
Texaco said there would be no further announcement "until these discussions are concluded."

Texaco said the venture being discussed would operate "some combination of U.S. downstream assets, including those of Star Enterprises." Star is a Texaco joint venture with Saudi Arabia that was formed in 1989.

"We also believe that a joint arrangement would enhance the ability of both companies to meet anticipated product requirements, and to improve results at a time of difficult downstream industry conditions," Texaco said in a press release.
